name: JMW Fabrication
old_description: Mobile welding and in house welding repair and fabrication. Steel, aluminum, stainless steel, cast iron, cast steel, stairs, railing, on site welding, equipment repair.
about:
JMW Fabrication was founded in 2003 in Quakertown, Pennsylvania. The company operates a full in-house fabrication shop and a mobile welding unit, serving customers across eastern Pennsylvania and New Jersey. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed, but the business emphasizes a customer-first model built on long-term relationships rather than one-off jobs.

The shop provides certified metal fabrication and repair, working with steel, stainless steel, aluminum, cast iron, and cast steel. Core processes include CNC plasma cutting, press braking, punching, shearing, metal forming, automated cold saw cutting, and SMAW, GMAW, and GTAW welding. Equipment includes a CNC plasma table, press brake, iron worker, and automatic cutting saws, which the company says can handle thousands of pieces per day for small, medium, and large production runs. Output ranges from one-off prototypes and custom architectural pieces — such as floating stairs and modern railings — to structural components and production parts.

JMW serves commercial, industrial, and residential clients, with projects spanning structural steel, architectural metalwork, stairs, railings, and equipment repair. The mobile welding rig brings on-site capability, including propane-powered units for indoor work where air quality is a concern. Welders hold American Welding Society certifications for D1.1 structural steel and D1.3 and D9.1 sheet metal across steel, stainless, and aluminum.

The company states its differentiators are quality craftsmanship, planning, communication, and diligence, with a focus on delivering projects right the first time. All major equipment is American-made, and the firm prioritizes buying from local suppliers when possible.
